title: Jammy Italian Rice Creamy Risotto
description: A creamy take on traditional Italian risotto, infused with wholegrain mustard for added depth of flavor and a dash of nostalgia.

ingredients.name: Arborio rice
ingredients.notes: Short-grain Italian rice that absorbs flavors well.

ingredients.name: Chicken broth
ingredients.notes: Homemade or store-bought, warmed to a simmer.

ingredients.name: Wholegrain mustard
ingredients.notes: Diluted in wine for a subtle kick.

ingredients.name: Spherified balsamic vinegar
ingredients.notes: For a pop of sweetness and acidity.

instructions: Heat butter in a large saucepan over medium heat, until melted and foamy.
Add Arborio rice, stirring to coat in butter and toast lightly, about 2 minutes.
Add white wine, stirring constantly, until completely absorbed.

Add 1/2 cup warmed chicken broth, stirring constantly until absorbed, and repeat in 1/2 cup increments until rice is cooked and creamy, about 25 minutes, adding diluted wholegrain mustard in the last 2 cups of broth.
Stir in Grana Padano cheese and Parmesan cheese until melted and well combined.
Taste and adjust seasoning as needed, then cover and let rest for 2 minutes.
To serve, scoop into bowls, topping with spherified balsamic vinegar and additional grated Parmesan cheese, if desired.
Cook poultry to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F before serving.
